listings.thesis: Plumbing and HVAC distribution could become a local bottleneck aggregator for water-intensive compute sites
listings.valuationNote: Qualitative valuation setup; no reliable non-US quote snapshot returned by finance tool

priorCase.rankRationale: Strict latent lens: FY26 EPS and target cuts on US (Morsco) margin erosion and weak US residential construction undercut the already-thin plumbing/HVAC compute-aggregator thesis. Core demand softening makes the data-center water-site repurposing story less credible, not more. Fundamentals weakening modestly.
